correctness.rationale: For p>=3, m>1 and strict interior b, original Khan--Rajan affine map has disjoint periodic intervals C_j of lengths c m^j/B and gaps U_s of lengths delta/m^s=qv_s. Other gaps flow deterministically to U_0, and U_0 maps affinely onto (0,1). The explicit first-return inverse branches on U_0 are separated similarities phi_s(w)=L-(delta/m^s)(w-b sum_{j<s}m^j); their attractor has unique similarity dimension d with sum_s (delta/m^s)^d=1. Finite affine preimages and boundary points preserve the global survivor dimension. Writing q^d sum v_s^d=1 proves endpoint laws as q->0,1. Conditioned uniform points in each gap remain uniform under affine branches, so geometric renewal with success c gives PGF c/(1-q sum_s v_s z^(s+1)), independent uniform-on-C entrance, phase m^j/B and exponential scaling. Independent exact rational p=3,m=2,b=1/5 recurrence gave P(T=0..4)=7/10,7/50,49/500,21/625,413/25000. These checks are only corroborative; infinite itinerary/dimension conclusions use strong separation and renewal proof.
